name: config
description: read or pin the effective config (providers/models/modules/budgets)
llm_description: Effective config. {action?:dump|get|set, section?, key?, value?}. dump shows both files or one merged {section}. get reads one dotted {key} of the merged config. set pins {key} to {value} in config.local.toml only, refusing unknown keys, mistyped values and table sections; applies from the next command. set checks the type, not the loader's semantic validation (enum spellings, ranges) — a value the loader refuses fails the next config load, so re-check with get/dump after setting an enum-like key.
